name: Adventure Bot
tagline: One map pin for an outing that fits the time and the mood you have
description: Tell it how long you have free and what sort of afternoon you are after, and it answers with a single place to go rather than a list to wade through. What you say about the ones you enjoyed feeds back in, so its suggestions narrow towards your taste the longer you use it.
author: SuddenlyJon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
